{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (trial['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = trial['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}')

# Check the unique values of assay_batch
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {trial["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_stats = trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(sample_seq_stats[sample_seq_stats > 1])}')

# Confirm the baseline biomarker is in ng/mL (no unit conversion needed)
print(f'biomarker_baseline dtype: {trial["biomarker_baseline"].dtype}')"}
